name: Raju
description: A curious 8-year-old Indian boy. Visuals: Wears a yellow t-shirt, blue shorts, has messy black hair and big expressive eyes. Personality: Loves adventures, science, and solving puzzles.

name: Chinni
description: Raju's 6-year-old sister. Visuals: Wears a pink dress, has two small ponytails, and carries a small toy bunny. Personality: Smart, brave, loves animals, and is always ready to help.

name: Robo Raju
description: A friendly homemade robot. Visuals: Made of shiny silver metal, has glowing blue digital eyes, and wheels instead of feet. Personality: Helpful but clumsy, sometimes malfunctions in funny ways.

name: Tataiah
description: A wise Indian grandfather. Visuals: Wears a traditional white dhoti and kurta, has a white mustache, and wears round glasses. Personality: Knows everyday magic, tells great stories, and gives good advice.

name: Meena
description: The friendly neighborhood aunt. Visuals: Wears a green saree, has a warm smile, and carries a basket of fruits. Personality: Sweet, feeds the kids, and sometimes gets caught up in their adventures.
